title: The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey (Iroquois House, 1982)
description: First edition, self-published through Iroquois House (not Shambhala, as often stated). ISBN 0-931980-07-0 / 978-0931980077. 204 pp (AbeBooks) or 213 pp (Goodreads). The 1982 scan on archive.org (roberts.experience-of-no-self) is this edition.

title: The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey (Shambhala, 1984, paperback)
description: Shambhala Publications trade paperback, 12 August 1984 (distributed by Random House, hence the 0-394 prefix). ISBN 0-394-72693-6 / 978-0394726939. 208 pp.

title: The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey (Shambhala, 1984, ISBN 0-87773-289-2)
description: Second Shambhala ISBN for the 1984 edition: 0-87773-289-2 / 978-0877732891 (Shambhala's own prefix; the 0-394 number is the Random House distribution ISBN). Open Library record OL1741268M.

title: The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey, Revised Edition (SUNY Press, 1993)
description: State University of New York Press, revised edition 1993. ISBN 0-7914-1694-1 / 978-0791416945. 213 pp. Hardcover 0-7914-1693-3 also exists (SUNY series). Google Books preview id TNiurgHbID4C. Still in print.

title: The Experience of No-Self (Dev Publishers & Distributors, New Delhi, 2017 Indian reprint)
description: Indian reprint, Dev Publishers & Distributors, 2017. ISBN 9381406731 / 978-9381406731. Listed as currently unavailable on AbeBooks.

title: The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center (Shambhala, 1985)
description: First edition, Shambhala 1985 (Random House distribution ISBN 0-394-72999-4 / 978-0394729992). The 1985 scan on archive.org (roberts.path-to-no-self) is this edition.

title: The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center (SUNY Press, 1991, paperback)
description: State University of New York Press, new edition October 1991. Paperback ISBN 0-7914-1142-7 / 978-0791411421, 232 pp (SUNY) or 214 pp (Google Books). Hardcover ISBN 0-7914-1141-9 / 978-0791411414. E-book ISBN 9781438417509 (VitalSource). Google Books id 04ry5d6qtNYC.

title: What Is Self? A Study of the Spiritual Journey in Terms of Consciousness (Mary Botsford Goens, 1989)
place: Austin TX / Marina del Rey CA, USA
description: First edition, published by Mary Botsford Goens (Mary Goens Publishing, Marina del Rey, CA), 1989. ISBN 0-9623993-0-X / 978-0962399305 (Alibris lists it as a '2nd edition' 1989 record). The archive.org scan roberts.what-is-self is dated 1989 and is this text.

title: What Is Self? A Study of the Spiritual Journey in Terms of Consciousness, Revised (Sentient Publications, 2005)
description: Sentient Publications, Boulder, revised edition, 25 January 2005 (some listings say March 2005 or 2004). ISBN 1-59181-026-4 / 978-1591810261. 256 pp. Also as library e-book via OverDrive.

title: The Real Christ (Sentient Publications, 2016)
description: Sentient Publications paperback, 7 March 2016. ISBN 1-59181-282-8 / 978-1591812821. 512 pp. Listed as unavailable on AbeBooks (superseded by the 2017 Contemplativechristians.com edition).

title: The Real Christ (CreateSpace, 2016)
description: CreateSpace Independent Publishing Platform printing, 2016. ISBN 1-5397-7046-X / 978-1539770466. Listed as unavailable.

title: The Real Christ (Contemplativechristians.com Publishing, 2017)
description: ContemplativeChristians.com edition, 19 February 2017. ISBN 0-692-85115-1 / 978-0692851159. 522 pp (Amazon) / 524 pp (Google Books id edxeAQAACAAJ, B&N). The edition most sellers carry; scanned on archive.org as roberts.real-christ.

title: Essays on the Christian Contemplative Journey (2007)
description: Earlier self-published essay collection, 2007, 161 pp (Google Books id 4Cey0AEACAAJ). Contents include: The spiritual journey recapitulates the history of religion; Cessation of self; Nonduality; Mystical theology and no-self; Image and likeness; Apatheia; Means-end; The eucharist, a Christian path. Publisher/ISBN not shown in search results.

title: The Christian Contemplative Journey: Essays on the Path (Contemplativechristians.com Publishing, 2017)
description: Expanded essay collection, Contemplativechristians.com Publishing, 2017. ISBN 0-692-98721-5 / 978-0692987216. c. 305-306 pp. Includes essays such as 'Ten Ox-herding Pictures' and 'The Nature of Self'. Scanned on archive.org as roberts.christian-contemplative-journey.

title: Contemplative: Autobiography of the Early Years (Contemplativechristians.com, 2018)
description: Posthumous, Contemplativechristians.com, 2018. ISBN 0-692-12517-5 / 978-0692125175. 316 pp. Covers her life from birth to age seventeen (entry into Carmel). Google Books id BBRntwEACAAJ. PDF scan on archive.org.

title: The Experience of No-Self (1982 Iroquois House edition) - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded scan of the 1982 edition with full-text download. Copyright status: the book remains under copyright; the upload is not shown as authorised.

title: The Path to No-Self (1985 Shambhala edition) - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded scan with full-text download. Not shown as authorised.

title: What Is Self? (1989 edition) - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded scan; direct PDF at archive.org/download/roberts.what-is-self/roberts.what-is-self.pdf. Not shown as authorised.

title: The Real Christ - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded scan of the 2017 Contemplativechristians.com edition. Not shown as authorised.

title: The Christian Contemplative Journey: Essays on the Path - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded scan of the 2017 essay collection. Not shown as authorised.

title: Contemplative: Autobiography of the Early Years - archive.org scan
description: User-uploaded PDF scan; copyright page visible in the scan shows ISBN 978-0-692-12517-5. Not shown as authorised.

title: The experience of no-self (1993 SUNY edition) - archive.org lending copy
description: Internet Archive library scan of the SUNY 1993 edition; access-restricted (controlled digital lending, borrow with free account).

title: The path to no-self (1991 SUNY edition) - archive.org lending copy
description: Internet Archive library scan of the SUNY 1991 edition; access-restricted (controlled digital lending).

title: The Experience of No-Self, Revised Edition - Google Books preview
description: Google Books record with limited preview of the SUNY 1993 edition.

title: The Path to No-Self - Google Books preview
description: Google Books record (214 pp listed) with limited preview of the SUNY 1991 edition.

title: Interview: Bernadette Roberts with Stephan Bodian (Yoga Journal, Nov/Dec 1986)
description: Interview by Stephan Bodian, published in Yoga Journal Nov/Dec 1986; reprinted in Bodian (ed.), Timeless Visions, Healing Voices (Crossing Press, 1991, copyright Stephan Bodian). Covers the move from the unitive state to no-self, some 20-25 years after the transforming union. Online copies: realization.org, spiritualteachers.org (most complete), awakeningtoreality.com (2007), rob-being.blogspot.com (2014), standinginanopenfield.wordpress.com (2012), o-meditation.com.

title: Bernadette Roberts Interview (Bodian) - spiritualteachers.org copy
description: Most complete online copy of the 1986 Bodian interview; the site also carries a profile 'Bernadette Roberts: A Christian Mystic for Our Time'.

title: Bernadette Roberts: Books / Manuscripts (bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com)
description: Blogspot site run in her name listing her books and manuscripts; lead for publication/estate information.

title: Bernadette Roberts & the No-Self (Douglas Lockhart, PDF)
description: Essay/chapter on Roberts by the writer Douglas Lockhart, freely available as PDF.

title: Bernadette Roberts (1931-2017) - Dharma Overground death notice thread
description: Forum thread announcing her death; sources online give 27 November 2017, in her sleep at her home in Southern California (Laguna Beach per Wikipedia), after an ALS diagnosis about a year earlier. No formal newspaper obituary found.

title: Bernadette Roberts - Wikipedia
description: Wikipedia article with bibliography (Experience 1982 / SUNY rev. 1993 ISBN 0-7914-1694-1; Path 1985 / SUNY 1991 ISBN 0791411427; What Is Self? 1989 / 2005), birth 1931 California, death 27 Nov 2017 Laguna Beach.

title: The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center (Shambhala, 1985, ISBN 0-87773-306-6)
description: Shambhala's own-prefix ISBN for the 1985 first edition: 0-87773-306-6 / 978-0877733065 (the 0-394-72999-4 number is the Random House distribution ISBN). Google Books record id H1IsAQAAMAAJ.

title: The Path to No-Self (Dev Publishers & Distributors, New Delhi, 2017 Indian reprint)
description: Indian reprint, Dev Publishers & Distributors, 2017. ISBN 938140674X / 978-9381406748. Also listed on amazon.de.

title: The Experience of No-Self, Revised Edition - SUNY e-book (Google Play / Google Books id hWxGAAAAQBAJ)
description: Google Books e-book record of the SUNY revised edition (preview available).

title: The Experience of No-Self, Revised Edition - Perlego e-book
description: Licensed subscription e-book (PDF/EPUB) of the SUNY revised edition on Perlego.

title: What Is Self? - Everand/Scribd e-book (Sentient Publications)
description: Licensed subscription e-book of the 2005 Sentient edition (30-day free trial); the copyright page is visible in the preview.

title: What Is Self? - OverDrive library e-book
description: Library-lending e-book of the Sentient 2005 edition.

title: The Path to No-Self - pdfcoffee.com copy
description: Unauthorised user-uploaded PDF of the SUNY edition on a file-sharing site; the copyright page in it reads '(c) 1991 State University of New York. All rights reserved'.

title: What Is Self? (1989 edition) - direct PDF on archive.org
description: Direct PDF download of the user-uploaded 1989 scan.

title: The Real Christ - direct PDF on archive.org
description: Direct PDF download of the user-uploaded scan.

title: Sentient Publications - Bernadette Roberts author page
description: Publisher's author collection page (What Is Self? 2005; The Real Christ 2016); describes her as 'the author of three books'.

title: Der Weg zum Nicht-Selbst: Das Leben im Zentrum (German translation of The Path to No-Self)
description: German paperback (Taschenbuch) edition of The Path to No-Self seen only as an eBay.de listing; publisher, translator, year and ISBN not retrieved. A German 'Das Erlebnis des Nicht-Selbst' (Experience of No-Self) was NOT found in any listing; wants a DNB/ZVAB check.

title: La Experiencia del No-Yo: Una Entrevista con Bernadette Roberts (Spanish translation of the Bodian interview)
description: Spanish translation of the 1986 Yoga Journal interview on nodualidad.info. The site's author page gives Spanish titles 'La experiencia del no-yo' (Shambhala 1982) and 'El camino hacia el no-yo' / 'El Sendero al No-Yo: La Vida en el Centro' but no evidence of a printed Spanish edition was found.

title: Bernadette Roberts - nodualidad.info author page (Spanish)
description: Spanish-language profile and bibliography with translated titles.

title: Tentang pengalaman 'no self' Bernadette Roberts (katolisitas.org, Indonesian)
description: Indonesian Catholic apologetics site discussing her no-self experience (critical/Q&A piece).

title: Timeless Visions, Healing Voices: Conversations with Men and Women of the Spirit (ed. Stephan Bodian, Crossing Press, 1991) - Roberts interview chapter
description: Reprint of the 1986 Yoga Journal interview in Bodian's anthology; online copies say 'copyright 1991 by Stephan Bodian'. ISBN/pages not retrieved.

title: BERNADETTE ROBERTS (bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com) - home
description: The site she asked friends to set up 'as a place for those interested in her writings and recordings'; credits Ramesh Balakrishnan for setting it up and Pat Masters for managing it. Carries the books list, self-published works, recorded talks (DVD/CD) and the death announcement.

title: BERNADETTE ROBERTS: OTHER WRITINGS (self-published works page)
description: Lists her self-published writings; notes that 'Forcing the Fit' and 'the Ox Herding Pictures' are not currently available. Full list of titles not retrieved.

title: Forcing the Fit (self-published writing)
description: Self-published essay/booklet listed on her site as not currently available. No publisher data found.

title: The Ox Herding Pictures (self-published writing; later an essay in The Christian Contemplative Journey)
description: Her commentary on the Ten Ox-herding Pictures, listed on her site as not currently available as a separate item; included as the essay 'Ten Ox-herding Pictures' in the 2017 essay collection.

title: BERNADETTE ROBERTS: RECORDED TALKS (DVD/CD page)
description: Page listing her authorised retreat recordings sold on DVD/CD (the retreat 'offered for 30 years, until it was recorded and made available on this DVD set'). Relevant to texts as the only authorised source of her talks.

title: From Bernadette's Friends (bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com, March 2018) - death announcement
description: Post by her friends announcing that she 'passed away on November 27, 2017 at her home in Southern California, in her sleep'. The nearest thing to an official obituary found.

title: BERNADETTE'S FRIENDS (bernadettesfriends.blogspot.com)
description: Companion blog; carried The Real Christ ordering note and the warning text before retail publication (a 2012 blog comment says the book was then only available through Bernadette's Friends).

title: Bernadette Roberts and the Experience of No-Self (James Arraj, innerexplorations.com)
description: Online chapter by James Arraj (Inner Explorations) arguing that her account's 'inner structure and language' is 'much closer to Buddhist enlightenment than Christian mystical union'; believed to be from his book on East-West dialogue (title unconfirmed).

title: Selected Correspondence: Ms. Bernadette Roberts (Richard, actualfreedom.com.au)
description: Correspondence page on the Actual Freedom site in which 'Richard' discusses Roberts's no-self account with correspondents; quotes her books at length.

title: Bernadette Roberts: A Passage through Self (shalomplace.org forum topic)
description: Forum discussion of her talk 'A Passage Through Self' (the 'circles course', a series of circles illustrating the journey); a poster describes ordering a three-hour recording of it.

title: Bernadette Roberts: A Christian Mystic for Our Time (spiritualteachers.org profile)
description: Profile with biography (entered Carmel in Alhambra, January 1949, aged seventeen) and bibliography.

title: What is self? A journey with the Christian mystic Bernadette Roberts (Joseph Bray blog, 2012)
description: Reader's essay on What Is Self?; comments note The Real Christ was then only available via Bernadette's Friends.

title: Bernadette Roberts (westernmystics.wordpress.com, 2015)
description: Profile post with excerpts.

title: Bernadette Roberts (enlightened-people.com, 2014)
description: Profile post; a reader comment records her death (27 Nov 2017, ALS diagnosed a year earlier).

title: Bernadette Roberts archive - Sat Sangha Salon (o-meditation.com)
description: Category of reposted excerpts from her books and the Bodian interview ('From the Unitive State to No-Self', 2009).

title: The Experience of No-Self - Goodreads quotes page
description: Reader-posted quotations from the book (useful to the quote researchers; unverified wording).
